department.en: Revenue Department, Govt of NCT of Delhi

summary.en: A Revenue Department certificate that you have lived in Delhi.
summary.hi: राजस्व विभाग का प्रमाण पत्र कि आप दिल्ली में रहते हैं।
summary.hn: Revenue Department ka certificate ki aap Delhi mein rehte hain.

text.en: A domicile certificate from the Revenue Department showing you have lived in Delhi.
You must be able to show continuous stay in Delhi for the last 3 years.
A minor's application needs a self-declaration from a major, since the applicant is under 18.
Aadhaar. It is not compulsory: if you have none, give any one identity proof from PAN, passport, driving licence or voter card. The name must match your application.
Present residence proof such as a voter card, electricity, water or telephone bill.
Proof of date of birth: birth certificate, school certificate or passport.
Proof of continuous stay in Delhi for the last 3 years, such as an education certificate, electricity bill, house tax or water bill.
Contact number and ID copy of the Class I gazetted officer who attested the form. All documents need to be attested by a gazetted officer.
Go to the SDM of your area, or the Deputy Commissioner's office, between 10:00 AM and 1:00 PM on any working day. You can also apply online on e-District.
Your photo is captured by webcam when you submit or at verification, and it should match the photo on your Aadhaar.
